answer: Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is checked against an open register. Time is the toll no farm can skip: 25 minutes per proof, 14625 minutes for 585, due every single epoch. Take the pearl away and the name goes; take the inlet away and the stake goes; take the terrace away and the past goes. Let every applicant face the same trial with Gem setter drilled bead seal faceted in the cutting loft, and let the answer read as each drilled bead is a measured gem yield plus a guild signature. Masks born together are graded together, and the farm's whole litter scores the same zero.
